objective: On newly exposed original source DEV seeds, separately measure public target-front encounter and selection-to-effect conditional on authentic exposure for an independent public-history graph/visitation explorer versus qualified unchanged native learners and two genuine source-selected controls. No science / no MG28 rollout.

design.cold_memory: retain independently source-selected experience only within one family across 3 fresh seeds, never share across roles or families; random has no memory
design.frontier_mechanism: Build visited original public image+direction contexts and state-action successor counts from solely own selected env.step feedback. Explore the least-known action from the present public context, prefer demonstrated transitions toward globally less-visited public contexts, discount repeated no-change transitions, and include count confidence. Never use source hidden pose, map, private inventory, target/door-specific scripted rules, reward shaping, or externally supplied actions.

frozen_frontier_scoring.state_key: sha256(public image,direction) no mission-derived path oracle
frozen_frontier_scoring.checkpoint: canonical JSON with context counters, observed successor hashes, full public digest history, total; must cold roundtrip

design.equal_information: all six roles see identical raw authentic public image/direction/literal mission, own selected actions/feedback only, same per-episode cap and original reset seed; native and controls unchanged
design.source_lineage: only historically declared prior seeds and MG32 parent tree searched, cannot guarantee unknown disconnected/private cohorts
design.resource_caveat: native Go child CPU/RSS and role-wide equal total-resource parity UNVERIFIED; host elapsed and Python CPU only are contextual, not valid cross-language resource parity

preregistered_report_metrics.target_front_frames: exact literal public mission object type/color at original public front [3][5] before selected step
preregistered_report_metrics.target_pick_attempt: own selected action 3 conditional on exact public target front
preregistered_report_metrics.target_effect: actual target object disappears with unchanged direction following own action 3
preregistered_report_metrics.door_front_frames: front public door object type4 locked state2; not proof actor has key
preregistered_report_metrics.toggle_attempt: own action 5 conditional on front locked door
preregistered_report_metrics.door_effect: actual locked state2 to open state0 after own toggle with same color and heading
preregistered_report_metrics.visited_contexts: unique before original public image/direction hashes
preregistered_report_metrics.zero_denominator: report numerator and denominator; never invent conditional rate if no exposure

development_filter.in_any_case: no scientific learning/transfer or MG28 activation; no heldout promotion
development_filter.prereg_role_attribution: report each family and role separately; never credit native with frontier effects
